provenance.purpose: L4 training-data scaling of the unchanged matched mean CNN and raw-set CNN, using a fixed 256-record budget.
provenance.selection: Nested UID-hash prefixes of 512, 2048 and all 7452 existing training Hamiltonians. The same 128 development validation Hamiltonians and per-H record indices are used throughout; no final-test payloads.
provenance.comparison: Thirty neural jobs: two methods, three training counts, five paired seeds. Seed-averaged metrics are not ensemble predictions. The verified completed inverse baseline is referenced once, without refitting or artificial seed/count replication.
provenance.training_policy: Common 200-epoch ceiling and early stopping, not equal optimizer-update or compute budgets. Full epochs have 32, 128 and 466 updates. Interpret the curve as performance under this training policy, not a pure data-count intervention at equal compute.
provenance.information: True fields are labels and scoring references only. Complete edge sums are sufficient under the fixed-support IID equilibrium likelihood; saved MCMC records are correlated and nominal counts are not effective independent samples.
provenance.architecture: Keep the two 38690-parameter architectures unchanged in this scaling study. Structural changes require a separate controlled comparison.
provenance.long_runs: User launches all research training. CUDA required; the shared .venv is used. Ctrl+C saves bounded progress. Immutable source/data/device bindings protect resume.
